# <img src="docs/Julia-logo.png" width="48" height="48" valign="middle"> Julia Programming Challenge

> 50-Day Julia Programming Challenge by Amey Thakur and Mega Satish, focused
> on computational modeling, high-performance computing, and machine
> learning.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575

Institution: Terna Engineering College, University of Mumbai
Programme: B.E. Computer Engineering

Repository created: 21 August 2021

- Mega, 6 files
- Parallel Computing, 10 files

- docs, 2 files
- Julia.ipynb
- JuliaOnColab.ipynb
